quarterly_data.quarter: Longsys results briefing Q&A: 2025 annual and Q1 2026 (04-30-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Head of finance Li Yuhua (2025 annual and Q1 2026 results briefing): Q1 2026 net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 38.62 hundred million and net profit excluding non-recurring items RMB 39.43 hundred million; independent director Tang Zhongcheng said inventory was RMB 179.61 hundred million at the end of Q1 2026, and chairman Cai Huabo said inventory is at a healthy, reasonable level matched to the business scale and that the overall business trend keeps improving.
quarterly_data.figure: Q1 2026 net profit RMB 38.62 hundred million (excluding non-recurring items RMB 39.43 hundred million); inventory RMB 179.61 hundred million

quarterly_data.quarter: Longsys results briefing Q&A: 2025 annual and Q1 2026 (04-30-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Chairman and general manager Cai Huabo (results briefing): AI deployment in the cloud and on devices is a clear trend bringing huge incremental storage demand; cloud-AI products such as HBM, RDIMM and eSSD already consume much existing capacity and on-device AI storage demand will be released further; wafer makers' capacity cannot currently meet demand and expansion takes time, so the storage industry will stay in short supply for some time. He said the company has long-term supply agreements (LTA) or MOUs with the major global memory wafer makers, and as their capacity and R&D shift to servers it will strengthen consumer storage in what he calls 'misaligned synergy' with them.

quarterly_data.quarter: Longsys results briefing Q&A: 2025 annual and Q1 2026 (04-30-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Products (results briefing): board secretary Xu Gangling said mSSD has won deep recognition from many leading PC makers and will reach scaled commercial use in 2026, and SOCAMM2 has been lit up; chairman Cai Huabo said that by internal tests SOCAMM2 uses only 1/3 the power of a standard DDR5 RDIMM with 2.5 times the bandwidth at the same capacity, but has no substantive revenue yet. Cai said the company does no dedicated HBM R&D, as HBM worldwide is led by the memory wafer makers.
quarterly_data.figure: SOCAMM2: 1/3 the power and 2.5x the bandwidth of a DDR5 RDIMM (internal tests)

quarterly_data.quarter: Longsys results briefing Q&A: 2025 annual and Q1 2026 (04-30-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Chairman Cai Huabo (results briefing): the TCM (technical contract manufacturing) model, which shares information among wafer maker, Longsys and customer, has completed technical and operational preparation and some cases have landed, but it is still a small share of revenue; it is a long-term strategic direction that he expects to lift profit contribution markedly once in place, and the company will keep raising its share. He said the company will selectively evaluate acquisitions at home and abroad in chip design, firmware development and packaging and test.
